520501.name: Crystal Missile
520501.description:
Fires crystals from its back.
The crystals can be intercepted.

520503.name: Barrier Burst
520503.description: Erects a crystal barrier in front of Nikkes that emits a laser after a certain period of time, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

520506.name: Big Crystal Missile
520506.description: Launches a huge crystal missile that can be intercepted with a certain number of hits.

520507.name: Crystal Light
520507.description: The sinister crystal exudes menace, inflicting a debuff on all Nikkes.

520508.name: Reflection Laser
520508.description: Deals damage to all Nikkes, whether they are hiding behind cover or not.

520509.name: Crystal Piercer
520509.description:
Fires a barrage of crystals, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Crystal Chamber generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while using Crystal Piercer. While the barrier is up, only Electric Code Nikkes can deal damage.
